It is the first Italian game to be created with the support of the Sardegna Film Commission. This morbid jigsaw puzzle is available on Nintendo Switch, PC, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S. The game has been described as a neon-folk horror game.
